purpose: Order a governor to hand over what his town is holding, and decide whether the Crown pays for it

options.text: on a matter that will not wait on the next ship
because there is nowhere else left to look
and I would rather not have had to
and I am past caring how it is received

steps.prompt: On what terms the {param:resource} is to be given up

options.label: buy it from the town at a fair price
options.text: I must have {param:amount} of {param:resource} out of {param:to}'s stores. The Treasury will pay for it at a fair reckoning — I am buying, not taking, and I would have the town know the difference{insert:warmth}.

warmth.pleased: . You have never given me cause to treat you otherwise

options.label: pay something towards it and say plainly it is not enough
options.text: I must have {param:amount} of {param:resource}. I can send {param:payment} against it, which is not what it is worth and we both know it. I would rather tell you that than dress it up.

options.label: take it, and offer nothing
options.text: You will send {param:amount} of {param:resource} to the quay. There is no payment and there will be none. I am aware what that means in a town that has been short all winter, and I am giving the order regardless{insert:cold}.

cold.hateful: . You may tell them it came from me

tone.pleased: With thanks I know are owed,
